summary: fetch options: dest directory (stored as dest/hostname/path), fail_on_missing, flat to skip the hostname/path structure, src file (not directories), and validate_checksum.
questions: Where does fetch store the file by default?
How do I fetch a file without the hostname directory structure?
Can fetch download a whole directory?
How do I disable checksum validation in fetch?

answer_card.title: fetch parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `src` (required): remote **file** (not a directory)
- `dest` (required): local dir; `/backup` + `/etc/profile` on `host.example.com` → `/backup/host.example.com/etc/profile`
- `flat` (false): skip hostname/path; if dest ends with `/` uses the basename. Files overwrite across hosts with same name
- `fail_on_missing` (true)
- `validate_checksum` (true)
